lentils.reason: Exact dry-form candidate, but the bounded Foundation record does not publish tracked fibre. Promoting it would reclassify current density blockers into nutrient-field gaps without completing a near-unlock recipe.

turkey_mince.reason: Raw ground form matches recipe timing, but 93/7 fat level is more specific than canonical turkey_mince and tracked fibre is unpublished. Do not claim exact generic equivalence or assume fibre zero.

cottage_cheese.description: Cottage cheese, full fat, large or small curd
cottage_cheese.reason: Full-fat status is more specific than canonical cottage_cheese and tracked fibre is unpublished.

tahini.reason: The record is nutritionally complete for tracked fields, but B8 does not equate every sesame butter record with canonical tahini without stronger identity review; it is not a current near-unlock target.

salt.reason: The exact extraction publishes energy but not the tracked protein, carbohydrate, fat or fibre fields. Missing fields remain unknown; B8 does not hardcode assumed zeros.

passata.reason: Crushed canned tomato is not passata/strained tomato purée.

edamame.reason: Authored recipe semantics do not establish that edamame is already prepared before the recipe step.

smoked_paprika.reason: The bounded Foundation 2026-04 catalogue produced no candidate. Generic paprika remains prohibited as a substitute for smoked paprika.

lemon.reason: The bounded Foundation 2026-04 catalogue produced no lemon candidate suitable for replacing the existing reviewed European composition lane.

basmati_rice.reason: The bounded Foundation 2026-04 catalogue produced no dry basmati candidate. B8 does not broaden composition-source classes merely to remove this blocker.
